decisions: Minutes of the June 11, 2025 board meeting approved as presented.
Q2 2025 financial report approved; Pierre Dubois authorized to renegotiate software vendor contracts targeting a minimum 10% cost reduction by September 30, 2025.

Margaret Holvan authorized to negotiate and execute contract renewal with Acme Corp, with a maximum permissible discount of 8% on the base service fee and an option to expand services into two additional verticals.
Aiyana Park directed to assign a dedicated account operations coordinator to Acme Corp no later than August 1, 2025.
Operations team to resolve tier-2 support response time issue for Acme Corp within 30 days, targeting a maximum 4-hour response SLA.

Hiring plan for five new positions approved; up to two recruitment agencies may be engaged; all shortlists must include a minimum of 40% candidates from underrepresented groups; target start date October 1, 2025.
OrbitDesk Pro approved as new CRM and project management platform; budget not to exceed $190,000; go-live target November 30, 2025.
External data privacy legal advisor approved for compliance gap analysis; budget cap of $25,000; to be completed by September 15, 2025.
Professional liability insurance policy to be renewed for 2025–2026 on existing terms; Pierre Dubois to execute renewal by July 31, 2025.
